messages.text: PR #49 has a comment to address
I’ll read the comment on PR #49, check the affected code and evidence, and address it on that PR’s branch.

The comment asks for the packing along z and a drawing of both prototypes. I’ll derive the dimensions from the existing models, including the module overlaps and the space occupied by end boards, cooling and cable collectors.

Both prototypes use the same z packing: 28 rows at an 85.333 mm pitch, giving 10.667 mm of projected active overlap between adjacent modules. The 1.5 mm alternating lift separates those overlaps physically. I’ll show the central seam and barrel-end clearances, including the collector’s conflict with the older endcap datum.

The packing report and drawing are complete. They show the central overlap, pickup clearance, nine bearing stations and barrel-end service allocation. The existing ten barrel controls pass, and the geometry and historical simulation files remain unchanged. I’m validating the documentation and logger before updating PR #49.
PR #49 now includes the packing description and drawing. Local checks pass; I’m waiting for the hosted build and finishing the session record.
The hosted build is running the coverage controls. I’ve also checked that PR #50 and PR #51’s checkouts remain clean, and copied only the new session record into the primary checkout.
The hosted module-coverage and z-packing checks have passed; the pixel-disc controls are now running. The drawing is embedded in PR #49 and available as SVG and PNG in the repository.
The pixel-disc controls passed. The hosted build has reached the compact-export regressions, with no failures reported so far.
The hosted short-strip controls passed, and the build is now checking the dashboard and documentation links. I’ll record the result and push the logging closeout once it finishes.
All geometry and export checks are green. The documentation validation is still running; no further model changes are needed for this comment.
The hosted build passed. I’m recording that result in the session log and pushing a final logging-only closeout to PR #49.

Addressed in [PR #49](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/pull/49).

Added a [dimensioned drawing]([redacted] and packing details for both prototypes, including overlaps, central seam, supports, cooling and end clearances. Geometry is unchanged.

Ten controls and the hosted build passed. Session logging is updated; CI is running again for the final logging-only commit.
